cards.title: OpenAI-compatible
cards.text: The provider for any server that speaks OpenAI's chat API: LM Studio, vLLM, OpenAI itself.

cards.title: Your endpoint
cards.text: LLM_ENDPOINT is required. A server that wants no key gets a placeholder.

cards.title: Standard usage
cards.text: Tokens in the standard fields and no cache markers, so the seam's defaults hold.
